qualification.education_qualification: Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, MBA/HR or PGDM (HR) or Master's in HR Management, Bachelor's in Engineering with Environmental specialisation
qualification.details: Civil Construction: Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering (B.E./B.Tech.) from recognized University/Institute with relevant cumulative experience in power sector including planning, construction, erection and commissioning of large thermal power projects including Rail/Road infra. Construction Engineering & Project: Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering (B.E./B.Tech.) from recognized university/institute with experience in engineering, project management, and execution of large thermal power projects including EPC contracts, design review, commissioning, and project monitoring of BTG/BoP/Rail packages. Electrical Engineering & Commercial: Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering (B.E./B.Tech.) from recognized university/institute with substantial experience in Electrical & commercial functions relating to thermal power projects including PPAs, tariff negotiations, regulatory matters. HR & Industrial Relations: Graduate with MBA/HR / PGDM (HR) / master's degree in HR Management, Personnel Management & Industrial Relations from recognized University/Institute with at least 10 years experience in HR Management in thermal power plants, infrastructure, heavy engineering or process industry. Environment Engineering & Management: Graduate in Engineering with specialisation in Environmental Engineering & Management with experience in Environmental Clearance / Forest Clearance activities / EMP, desirable experience in thermal power plants, infrastructure, heavy engineering or process industry.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for DCPPL Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 18-09-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

Electrical Engineering & Commercial: Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering (B.E./B.Tech.) from recognized university/institute with substantial experience in Electrical & commercial functions relating to thermal power projects including PPAs, tariff negotiations, regulatory matters. HR & Industrial Relations: Graduate with MBA/HR / PGDM (HR) / master's degree in HR Management, Personnel Management & Industrial Relations from recognized University/Institute with at least 10 years experience in HR Management in thermal power plants, infrastructure, heavy engineering or process industry. Environment Engineering & Management: Graduate in Engineering with specialisation in Environmental Engineering & Management with experience in Environmental Clearance / Forest Clearance activities / EMP, desirable experience in thermal power plants, infrastructure, heavy engineering or process industry.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for DCPPL Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 18-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DCPPL recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 18th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this DCPPL recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies for the posts of Consultant / Senior Consultant / Advisor / Senior Advisor in DVC CIL Power Private Limited.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: The educational qualifications vary by post, including Bachelor's degrees in Civil, Mechanical, or Electrical Engineering, or an MBA/PGDM (HR) or Master's in HR Management, or an Engineering degree with an Environmental specialization.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the DCPPL consultant posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the consultant positions is 65 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary for these contractual positions ranges from Rs. 75,000 to Rs. 1,50,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for DCPPL recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to apply by sending their application via Email.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for DCPPL recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for DCPPL consultant roles?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of CVs followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q9. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by DVC CIL Power Private Limited (DCPPL).

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location for these DCPPL posts?
faq.answer: The job location is Chandrapura, Jharkhand.
